title: WikiPulse dead-letter event v1
description: Event that could not be processed, written to topic wikipulse.page_change.dlq.v1 with the reason attached. The payload is the upstream event after pseudonymisation of performer fields where the payload parsed; unparseable payloads are stored as received.

reason_detail.description: Validator message or exception summary, e.g. the failing JSON pointer.

source_position.description: SSE Last-Event-ID for ingest failures, or topic/partition/offset for downstream failures.

payload.description: Original event JSON, truncated to 900000 bytes to stay under the 1 MB Event Hubs message limit.
